gap: Compliance catalog and systems projections do not apply the environment scope used by evidence and POA&M reads.
required_response: Use one explicit read-scope contract before host/count aggregation. Prove hidden-environment behavior through real routes.

gap: The matrix, evidence detail, and verification paths do not use identical complete/enforced policy-context matching rules.
required_response: Define compatible assessment-set selection once. Preserve intentional display-only differences with an explicit authority label.

gap: Evaluation-attempt fallback can select latest results per rule without an exact deployed-target binding or one common attempt.
required_response: Expose candidate evidence separately. Require one identified complete observation set for a current-result claim.

gap: Some current-state reads validate the newest report; policy verification first filters to nonempty store paths.
required_response: Test a newer invalid report after an older valid report. Decide whether last-known state is an explicit secondary mode.

gap: Multi-bundle selection changes the reported selection or filename, but the export body is built from the original single bundle.
required_response: Fetch and serialize exactly the chosen bundle set. Reject an empty selection and never include a deselected bundle.

gap: Evidence export does not pass the selected immutable bundle revision to each evidence request.
required_response: Bind each export item to a validated bundle/version pair and preserve that pair through every request and file.

gap: Filtered export rows can retain unfiltered totals. The native JSON projection omits important evidence and version identities.
required_response: Define report scope and count units. Carry a provenance envelope or label the result as a non-replayable summary.

gap: The OSCAL generator assigns classification, sensitivity, observation times, and evaluation metadata without corresponding authoritative inputs.
required_response: Require sourced values or represent them as unspecified. Separate export time from observation time. Validate emitted formats independently.

gap: Clean filtering checks only Fail and Warn, so incomplete or error-only hosts can enter a clean selection.
required_response: Define clean from completeness, errors, conflicts, and applicable evaluated results. Use the same predicate in export.

gap: Waiver-only evaluated hosts can satisfy the fully-compliant predicate while receiving a zero Pass-based score.
required_response: Name technical pass rate, accepted risk, evaluation coverage, and compliance policy separately. Approve any formula change explicitly.

gap: An unknown bundle/version deep link can fall back to another selection; the heading can retain current-pointer metadata for a selected revision.
required_response: Fail explicitly for an unavailable exact selection. Render heading metadata from the selected version.

gap: POA&M-to-evidence navigation eagerly evaluates candidates[0] inside then_some when no valid bundle candidate exists.
required_response: Handle zero, one, and multiple candidates without indexing before the cardinality check. Preserve direct-policy navigation.

gap: The Compliance POA&M host omits the exact-CVE Evidence callback, while the common tray still exposes policy-oriented finding controls.
required_response: Make finding-family capabilities explicit and provide a valid exact-CVE return path from every caller.

gap: The compact POA&M table uses policy finding_count for a CVE-only plan even though the API supplies cve_finding_count.
required_response: Render the active finding family and its count, not a zero policy count described as all findings.

gap: Verify now is offered outside awaiting_verification, but the service rejects verification in those states.
required_response: Render server-supported lifecycle capabilities and retain server enforcement.

gap: Successful Verify reloads with draft reset and does not call the parent change callback.
required_response: Preserve unrelated unsaved edits and publish a verification/revision invalidation event. Distinguish saved and draft values.

gap: Plan, assignment, policy, and release mutations refresh different local projections without a common dependency contract.
required_response: Define mutation receipts and affected-resource invalidation across Systems, CVEs, Compliance, and exports.

evidence_status: Source-confirmed edit-state risk; persistence effect unverified
gap: Bundle requirement editing can begin with an empty selection while hydration is pending or failed.

gap: Assignment edit/deactivate presentation is not consistently role-gated; local drafts and parent caches can retain prior assignment state.
required_response: Use explicit capabilities, immutable assignment-version preconditions, and committed readback. Keep Admin/CSRF enforcement.

gap: The audited control UI refers to a separate waiver workflow but provides no inspected request/decision entry point.

gap: First-page candidate limits lack continuation, and the tray policy linker excludes observation-only legacy contexts that other entry points support.

gap: Initial evidence loading lacks the normal close path, and a failed coverage request can retain its last-request marker and prevent a simple retry.
required_response: Keep dismissal and retry available in loading and failed states. Test stalled requests and repeated same-selection retries.

gap: Systems filters, remediation indicators, assignment context, and artifact source/type/time hierarchy differ from the design reference.
required_response: Resolve the detailed Section 18 matrix, then inspect exact-head rendered pairs. Do not invent missing metadata.

gap: Generic policy POA&M creation commits before loading response detail; a later read failure can be reported after the write succeeds.
required_response: Define a committed-result receipt or construct authoritative response data before commit. Test retry and lost-response reconciliation.

gap: Policy default milestones use fixed offsets through day 56 even when the user chooses an earlier target completion date.

gap: Some inspected basic bundle handlers lack an explicit local CSRF check; assignment and POA&M mutations do have checks.
